selection_example.conditioning: thirds of absolute contemporaneous reduced-form price innovation; illustrative mathematical confounding, not calibrated to real regimes

source_findings: Uses dx and forward-aligned flow rather than innovations from a declared dynamic reduced form
Rolling 60-bin price-level volatility includes current price and backward-fills initialization
Regimes use pooled quantiles of an endogenous measured state
Fits unweighted covariance discrepancies with one initialization
Bounds lambda and alpha to [-1,1] and standard deviations to [.01,5], excluding other observationally equivalent branches
No independent justification of invariant slopes, conditional structural-error orthogonality, variance-profile separation, or shock labels
Optimizer success is not a causal identification or uncertainty certificate
limits: Distinct nonproportional variance shifts can identify a mixing matrix only under defended restrictions and labeling/scaling
External sign/exclusion information could distinguish branches, but the code bounds alone are not that evidence
The endogenous-selection simulation illustrates an assumption failure; it does not estimate actual structural error correlations
